Unstructured magnitude pruning baseline at 20% sparsity.

Zeros out the smallest-magnitude weights globally across all linear layers,
then evaluates on GSM8K. Compares against RASP structured pruning at the

Input:  original model path

"""

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os

import numpy as np
import torch
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from eval_gsm8k import evaluate, set_seed

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEFAULT_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"
OUTPUT_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/results"


def apply_magnitude_pruning(model, sparsity: float):
    """Apply global unstructured magnitude pruning by zeroing smallest weights.

    Returns pruning statistics dict.
    """
    all_weights = []
    param_info = []

    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        if param.dim() < 2:
            continue
        if any(skip in name for skip in ["embed", "lm_head", "norm"]):
            continue
        all_weights.append(param.data.abs().flatten())
        param_info.append((name, param.data.shape, param.data.numel()))

    all_magnitudes = torch.cat(all_weights)
    total_prunable = all_magnitudes.numel()
    n_prune = int(total_prunable * sparsity)

    threshold = torch.kthvalue(all_magnitudes, n_prune).values.item()
    logger.info(f"Magnitude threshold for {sparsity:.0%} sparsity: {threshold:.6f}")

    total_zeroed = 0
    layer_stats = []
    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        if param.dim() < 2:
            continue
        if any(skip in name for skip in ["embed", "lm_head", "norm"]):
            continue
        mask = param.data.abs() <= threshold
        n_zeroed = mask.sum().item()
        total_zeroed += n_zeroed
        param.data[mask] = 0.0
        layer_stats.append({
            "name": name,
            "shape": list(param.data.shape),
            "total": param.data.numel(),
            "zeroed": n_zeroed,
            "sparsity": n_zeroed / param.data.numel(),
        })

    actual_sparsity = total_zeroed / total_prunable
    logger.info(f"Pruned {total_zeroed:,} / {total_prunable:,} = {actual_sparsity:.2%} actual sparsity")

    return {
        "target_sparsity": sparsity,
        "actual_sparsity": actual_sparsity,
        "threshold": threshold,
        "total_prunable_params": total_prunable,
        "total_zeroed": total_zeroed,
        "n_layers_pruned": len(layer_stats),
        "layer_stats": layer_stats,
    }

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Unstructured magnitude pruning baseline")

    parser.add_argument("--sparsity", type=float, default=0.20)
    parser.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, default=OUTPUT_DIR)

    )

    total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
    logger.info(f"Model loaded: {total_params:,} parameters")

    # Apply unstructured pruning
    logger.info(f"Applying magnitude pruning at {args.sparsity:.0%} sparsity...")
    prune_stats = apply_magnitude_pruning(model, args.sparsity)

    # Validate forward pass

    stats_summary = {k: v for k, v in prune_stats.items() if k != "layer_stats"}
    with open(stats_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(stats_summary, f, indent=2)
    logger.info(f"Pruning stats saved to {stats_path}")

    # Evaluate on GSM8K
    logger.info("Loading GSM8K test set...")
    dataset = load_dataset("openai/gsm8k", "main", split="test")
    if args.max_samples is not None:

    logger.info(f"Evaluating on {len(dataset)} samples")

    )

    eval_output = {
